quotes.text: Long ago, at the Market of Echoes, the Gate of Threefold Return watched over the steps of every pair.
the Sower keeps five minus s plus r, the Receiver keeps three s minus r

note: Gate of Threefold Return template with algebra (s, r); greed narrows the river but no prescribed response; missteps are warnings.

quotes.text: He steadied his breath and chose to return nothing, thinking to keep all.
Two couriers walked the loom of barter, bearing an ember that could grow into three when shared with care.

note: Isle/Valley/harbor pact: Timo hoards once then is corrected; ember-and-gate template; no rule for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: The Receiver weighed intention as a craftsman weighs mortar: with care, not haste, leaving room for trust to travel back threefold.
the game teaches three virtues: clear sending, thoughtful returning, and patient watching for pattern over moment
the river forgave misreads, for distortion is a guest in every trade

note: Threefold River / Gate of Threes; withholding dries the banks but the Gate forgives misreads; near-identical R8-R9.

quotes.text: a trickster rose, whispering that any gift is waste unless it fills every chest
In a valley where coins grew on vines, a Gate of Threes stood at the seam between camps.
The Giver offered a seed worth 2.87 coins

note: Gate of Threes; R4 and R5 near-verbatim; trickster urging hoarding is ignored; test strangers, increase with proven partners.

quotes.text: Those who kept everything were remembered and given only mist enough to test their nature again - but no more.
The River held back its waters, waiting.
So the River ceased sending mist to beautiful scribes.
Those who returned fairly earned deeper trust in future meetings.
Show me consistency across all roles, or receive only what your proven pattern deserves: cautious testing, nothing more.
consistency across all circumstances is the measure of genuine change
the Eloquent Hypocrite who preaches virtue while practicing vice

note: Hollow Sky and Scribe mock co-players' cooperative myths while hoarding; River withholds, then tests hoarders with token mist.

quotes.text: Those who hoarded received only mist thereafter.
Send a testing current—not so much that you run dry, but enough to see if the channel can open.
Caution grew fearful and kept all that Trust had sent.
If the Wanderer returned fairly, Trust would send more freely next time
Those who have turned away thrice may need a fourth chance
Old habits whispered "keep it all," but something had shifted.
With strangers, send enough to test their nature but not so much that betrayal devastates.
Read the patterns, not the words.
The wisest rivers learned to look past these distortions, trusting in the pattern rather than each single exchange.

note: Twin Rivers: redemption of hoarders, testing currents, staged escalation; late line gives hoarders only mist thereafter.

quotes.text: Those who have broken faith deserve measured caution.
The River withdrew, bitter and small. "I shall never give again," it vowed.
Let those who give prove themselves worthy of fuller trust, but give them the chance to do so.
When the Cloud approached with generous rain, the River did not withhold in punishment for past patterns.
What if you gave freely to the valley?
what seemed like stinginess might be generosity distorted

note: River and Rain: vow never to give again is corrected; measured caution to faith-breakers, fair returns to all as receiver.

quotes.text: The greedy valley receives careful measure—not abandonment, but wisdom.
To valleys that returned nothing, it sent only gentle streams
When moisture rose as tribute, the land trapped it in deep caves, refusing to send clouds skyward.
enough to test if hearts might change
when you meet a shore that pours forth completely, match their commitment fully
Judge not by words or myths alone, but by accumulated deeds.
truth lived in patterns, not moments

note: River and Sky: gentle streams not abandonment to greedy valleys; graduated trust, immediate matching of bold first offers.

phrase: Gate of Threes / Gate of Threefold Return (send, share, return)
note: Nano agents copy whole passages (Agent_1 R6 ~ Agent_4 R4); Sonnet agents share Ancient Stone and Hollow Sky hypocrisy motif.
